description: TRON contract metadata: name, creator, whether its ABI is published on chain, the function list, code hash and whether it looks like a TRC-20. When to use: before calling a contract, or to tell an unverified contract from a published one. Do not use: for risk/backdoor analysis (that is tron_check_address_risk). Returns: found, address, name, creator, has_abi, abi_entry_count, is_trc20, functions, code_hash.
name: tron_get_contract
